title: Ultrasensitive simultaneous detection of lead and cadmium in water using gold nanocluster-modified gold electrodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17535-17547
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02612A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shunyao Jia, Yuanping Li, Yaoning Chen, Yanting Wu, Tianyun Zhou, Nianping Chi, GuoWen He, Wei Zhang, Wenqiang Luo, Hao Li, Yumei Deng
Novel GNPs-Au modified electrode enables ultrasensitive detection of Pb2+ and Cd2+ (1 ng L−1 LOD) with 7.2-fold enhanced sensitivity. Achieves 90–113% recovery in real water samples. Ideal for environmental monitoring applications.
